## Deputies Elections

There have been 8 elections (8 contested) for Deputy held in St Helier No 1 since 2002.

* * *

### 2002 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy (3 seats), 27th November 2002.

**[Patrick Ryan](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/patrick-ryan), [Judy Martin](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/judy-martin) and [Jerry Dorey](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/jerry-dorey) were elected as Deputies of St Helier No 1 in 2002.**

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[Patrick Ryan](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/patrick-ryan)** |  | 720 | 69.9% |
| 2 | **[Judy Martin](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/judy-martin)** |  | 660 | 64.1% |
| 3 | **[Jerry Dorey](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/jerry-dorey)** |  | 488 | 47.4% |
| 4 | [Peter Pearce](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/peter-pearce) |  | 352 | 34.2% |
| 5 | [Chris Whitworth](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/chris-whitworth) |  | 252 | 24.5% |

1,030 ballots (inc. 8 spoilt papers)

3,483 registered voters

29.6% turnout

### 2014 St Helier No 1 Deputy By-Election

Following the loss of a libel action regarding a satirical cartoon, [Trevor Pitman](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/trevor-pitman) and [Shona Pitman](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/shona-pitman) were disqualified from the States in January 2014 after being declared bankrupt (1 seat), 5th March 2014.

**[Nick Le Cornu](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/nick-le-cornu) was elected as Deputy of St Helier No 1 in 2014**.

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[Nick Le Cornu](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/nick-le-cornu)** |  | 248 | 33.2% |
| 2 | [Gordon Forrest](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/gordon-forrest) |  | 201 | 26.9% |
| 3 | [Paul Le Claire](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/paul-le-claire) |  | 178 | 23.8% |
| 4 | [Roy Travert](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/roy-travert) |  | 70 | 9.4% |
| 5 | [Maureen Morgan](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/maureen-morgan) |  | 51 | 6.8% |

748 votes

4,915 registered voters

15.2% turnout

_Registered voters estimated._
